data.name: GooseEndBreakEarlyLines
data.value: Cutting your break short? Bold move. Your future self will remember this. Back already? The break isn't over yet, but who am I to judge. (I'm judging.) Honk. Some of us take our breaks very seriously. Fine, fine. But don't come crying to me when your focus runs out. You woke me up for this? Your brain was enjoying that.
data.comment: When the goose is woken up mid-nap. One per line; it picks one at random.

data.name: GooseStillOnBreakLines
data.value: I can hear you clicking. Are you actually taking your break? That doesn't sound like a break to me. Go stretch your legs! Still at the computer? Your break is waiting for you over there, away from the screen. Breaks work better when you get up. Just saying. Honk. I can't nap with all that typing going on.
data.comment: When the computer is used during the break. One per line; it picks one at random.

data.name: GooseEndBreakAnywayLines
data.value: I'm not mad. I'm just disappointed. Wow. Okay. I'll just sit here and remember this. Ending your break to keep working? Bold. Your back is going to file a complaint. Your break, your call. I'm just a goose who believed in you. Fine. But don't come honking to me when your focus runs out.
data.comment: When the user wants to end the break early anyway. One per line; it picks one at random.

data.name: GooseSessionDone
data.value: That's it for this focus session: {0} of focus since {1:HH:mm}. Time to wrap up and give your brain some rest.
data.comment: {0} is how long, like "2 h 5 min"; {1} the time the session started.

data.name: DefaultMessages
data.value: Time to stand up and stretch those legs. Look at something far away for 20 seconds. Your eyes will thank you. Hydration check! Go get a glass of water. Step away from the screen. Whatever you're working on will still be there in five minutes. Shoulders down, jaw unclenched, take a deep breath. Go for a short walk. Even geese waddle around now and then. Hyperfocus is a superpower, but even superheroes take breaks. Have you eaten something today?
data.comment: One per line. Keep the same number of lines, in the same order, in every language: a message that's still a default switches along when the language changes.
